title: Asase ne Wim Ntam
intro: Ahintasɛm ɔkra bi retwɛn wo wɔ ɔsoro abakɔsɛm nkratafa kronkron no mu, a okura nsɛnkyerɛnne ne anwonwade ahorow a ɛda so ara ka wɔ mfe no mu. Berɛ a wodi nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ akwan akyi no, wobɛtu kwan afa asɛm bi a anwonwadeɛ ahyɛ no agyiraeɛ mu — ɛfiri anwonwadeɛ mfitiaseɛ kɔsi foro a ɛboro wim. So wubetumi ahu akoa a wɔahyira no yi ansa na woahu nea etwa to?
clues: Wɔsomaa me sɛ ɔbɔfoɔ kɔɔ Israelfoɔ nkyɛn de mmɔborɔhunu ne hann ho asɛm.
Na m’awoɔ yɛ anwonwadeɛ sɛnkyerɛnne — mebaa wiase yi mu a na minni agya, ɛnam Ade Nyinaa so Tumfoɔ no ahyɛdeɛ so.
Mekasae bere a na meda so ara yɛ akokoaa, na mebɔɔ ​​me maame nidi ho ban wɔ ne nkurɔfo sobo ahorow ho.
Ɛnam Allah kwan so no, mede dɔteɛ nwene nnomaa na mehome nkwa guu wɔn mu — wɔtu kɔeɛ wɔ wɔn a wɔhwɛɛ no ​​ani so.
Mesaa wɔn a wɔwoo wɔn anifuraefoɔ yareɛ, mesaa ɔkwatani no yareɛ, na menyanee awufoɔ mpo — nanso anwanwadeɛ biara nam Allah kwan so, na ɛnyɛ me deɛ.
Bere a m’atamfo no bɔɔ pɔw sɛ wɔbɛsɛe me no, Allah maa me so kɔɔ soro na ɔhyɛɛ bɔ sɛ mɛsan aba ansa na Atemmu Da no adu.

trial.label: Bere a Ɛkyerɛkyerɛ Mu
options: Wɔtow me guu ogya a ɛredɛw mu
Mihyiaa Farao dɔm a wɔyɛ den no
Meyɛɛ adaka wɔ bepɔ no so

location.label: Nsɛnkyerɛnne Kronkron a Wɔyɛ
options: Mede yoma ababaa bi firii ɔbotan mu baeɛ

outcome.label: Nea Ɛbɛyɛɛ Me
options: Wɔama wɔn so akɔ soro; hyɛɛ bɔ sɛ ɔbɛsan aba
Ɔdii me nkurɔfoɔ firii nnommumfa mu
Wɔmaa no asase so ahonyade a ɛso bi nni
Wɔsan ne m’abusua boom bere a yɛatetew mu bere tenten akyi
outcome.answer: Wɔama wɔn so akɔ soro; hyɛɛ bɔ sɛ ɔbɛsan aba

arabic: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا عَبْدٌ أَنْعَمْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
verse: He [i.e., Jesus] was not but a servant upon whom We bestowed favor, and We made him an example for the Children of Israel. (43:59)
